procedure.method: Independent fresh-session craft review of only the exact listed pins. Verified every listed SHA-256 and byte count; read packet, literal case, rules, rubric, method/addendum and pinned helper code. The packet declares no source assets or protected layouts, so both source receipt arrays are explicitly empty. Read all five pinned poster native-evidence manifests before the first poster open; did not follow their unlisted embedded paths. Used tools.view_image with detail:'original' and emitted each returned image visibly through functions.exec, sequentially M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4, M5 in the same three-view order. All 15 exact poster views were actually visible before beginning the first poster-copy reading/transcription stage, any judgment or any score. First readings below were then transcribed from those already-opened native views; usage720 and thumbnail320 observations use the corresponding already-opened reductions. No asset replacement, crop, image edit, OCR, new image, peer review, subagent, fork or resume. No additional image opens or ambiguity revisits occurred. PNG dimensions and RGB opacity were checked read-only after actual visual opening; helper/statistical success is not the basis of the viewed attestations. Session identity is left null for the runner.
